anomalies.observed: The schematic connects PR7 (LiDAR) through P3 to +5V, GND, and the main I2C SDA/SCL nets.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the TF-Luna is not wired: its pins are free and it is not connected to any net.

evidence.quote: PR7 LiDAR connects through P3; pins are wired to +5V, NET0086, NET0069, and GND. Sheet 1, page 1.
The netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design.

anomalies.impact: Unlike the specified unwired LiDAR, a connected module will be powered and placed on the main I2C bus. This changes the board’s sensor interface and may affect bus operation; the documented firmware has no TF-Luna support.

parsed.summary: The schematic wires a LiDAR module to power and the main I2C bus, contrary to the specification’s explicit description of the TF-Luna as unwired. The other observed features are consistent with the stated design or documented limitations.
